The department may promulgate rules relating to requirements for flood mitigation applicable to an ADU in the coastal flood risk area or 10-year rainfall flood risk area.
(L.L. 2024/127, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
Section BC U204: ADU Detached from the Primary Dwelling
